summary: Fixed six of seven reported side issues in one pass: switched the markdown link renderer to a plain function so `this.parser` resolves, added a non-side-effecting `session.read` protocol request used by the store's inspect path, stopped dropping project/extension events whose session id differs from the open thread, scoped `setWorkingVisible(false)` so it cannot hide a streaming session, and seeded `sessionStates` from the session catalog instead of resetting to idle. Deleted the stray `word-wrap-issue.png` and verified the console is clean after a reload. The web extension registry was re-checked and found not to need a change.
decisions: Convert the `marked` link override to a plain function so `marked`'s bound `this.parser` is available, instead of relying on a parser on the module-level renderer.
Add a dedicated read-only `session.read` protocol request, server handler, and client method so inspecting a session no longer requires a double resume.
Stop filtering project status and extension events by the current session id on the client; let the reducer's project-path matching decide relevance.
Scope `setWorkingVisible(false)` to the extension's own message/spinner only, so a streaming session keeps its titlebar and transcript indicator.
Have the session catalog carry a `state` field sourced from the resident runtime and seed `sessionStates` from it on connect, rather than resetting all known sessions to idle.
Leave the web extension registry as-is after re-reading it: it replaces its set wholesale and was not add-only.
errors: Initially one resync test failed because the extension descriptor fixture was missing the required `capabilities` and `version` fields from `extensionDescriptorSchema`; fixed by adding those fields to the test event.
A file-length check failed for `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts` at 309 lines against a 302-line pre-existing limit; acknowledged but not changed in this pass.
